scope: Remove unused legacy workflows while preserving adaptive and its creation dependencies.
authorization: The user explicitly requested removal; no additional compatibility period or replacement workflow is introduced.

steps.description: Remove the old heavy/light, hook, ticket, job, and superpowers families plus the eight kernel helpers used only by them; preserve all adaptive sources and the ten creation helpers.
Remove exclusive legacy suites and fixtures, retain shared tests, and migrate shared annotation tests away from retired producers.
Repair creation fixture boundaries and review failures, preserving native registration, publication, failure, artifact, and human review coverage.
Update current guidance and catalogs, run all retained suites, and confirm adaptive production files are unchanged.
